description.value: Desert Hills Ranch is a family-owned BC farm operation since 1983, rooted in Ashcroft's rich volcanic soil and known for fresh produce. Their Cache Creek Taco Stand is a Mexican food outlet positioned on the Cariboo Highway (Hwy 97), making it a convenient warm-meal stop for cyclists traversing the Thompson River corridor. The stand operates under the same family umbrella as the main Ashcroft farm market, giving it a distinctly local character.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this OSM record corresponds to the 'Cache Creek Taco Stand' operated by Desert Hills Ranch at '2520, Hwy 97, Cache Creek, BC' — the same location as the OSM coordinates (lat ~50.82, lon ~-121.35 places it in the Cache Creek area). The phone number 778-257-1433 matches exactly between OSM and website. No amenity details (bike parking, washrooms, water, menu specifics, Wi-Fi) are mentioned anywhere on the website for the taco stand location, so all cyclist-relevant amenity fields remain null.
